name: S2-COMPRESSED-ACT row 6: the first bootable clip act — the opening stretch of Emerald Hill Zone act 1
note: WHY THIS RECTANGLE. (1) It is two sections wide, which is what staged plan row 6 asks for; its height is 1024 and not 2048 because EHZ's whole crop is 128 tiles tall (zone.json extent.crop_tiles) and R9 refuses a rect past it. (2) src == dst, so the paste SHIFT is (0,0): R12's 16-px block quantum is satisfied by construction, and a collision misalignment — which moves ground 8 px and which no screenshot shows — cannot hide behind a nonzero shift here. (3) dst (0,0) puts painted geometry in SECTION 0, which is the section whose block blob and local map own the map.toml head labels (OJZ_Sec0_Blocks / OJZ_Sec0_LocalMap); an all-air section 0 would content-dedup into an `equ` alias of some other section and the placement rows would name a label that is not a section head. (4) It is the opening of Emerald Hill act 1 — flat ground under the whole spawn column, the first hill, palm trees — which is the most recognisable ground in Sonic 2 and therefore the clearest possible answer to 'is this our engine drawing Sonic 2'. (5) EHZ has ZERO cells on CRAM line 0 (verified in its zone.json counts, not assumed), so the palette defect parcel 2 measured in CPZ and WFZ cannot appear here.
